subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, Plan mode, and Goal continuation as core runtime behavior now, and should PR #102261 land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request changes core interactive behavior and multiple public surfaces, so automation cannot choose the product scope, sequencing, or ownership boundary safely.

options.title: Split Staged PRs
options.body: Keep the hub open and review question infrastructure, Plan mode, and Goal driver as separately landable slices with focused proof.

options.title: Sponsor Full Branch
options.body: Accept the large review cost and drive PR #102261 through fresh maintainer review, proof, and any required hardening as one feature branch.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Choose a smaller core seam or plugin/API route and reshape or close the broad parity branch accordingly.

recommendation.title: Split Staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep the hub open and review question infrastructure, Plan mode, and Goal driver as separately landable slices with focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on agent runtime mode semantics and update_plan/strict-agentic behavior, where this history shows the strongest current feature ownership signal.
